title: Stickers for the Trash Can – 4-Pack Cartoon Designs
descriptionHtml:
All gray trash cans look the same. Yours too.

The trash can stands right at the front of the driveway and is the first thing people see. Gray plastic, a house number scribbled with a marker – and exactly like the neighbor's, so after collection day you still stand there lifting the lid to figure out which one is yours.

The solution: four faces, four trash cans with their own personality

One that laughs out loud and winks, one that sticks out its tongue, one that smiles big – and one that cries about being the one who has to be the trash can. Stick one on each can, and you can see from the door which one is yours, and the can everyone pretends doesn't exist becomes the funniest thing on the street.

Features

  • You can see which can is yours from the door – four different faces: winking laugh, tongue out, big smile and crying
  • Rain and slush wipe off with a cloth – smooth PVC surface with no texture that collects dirt
  • Applied by hand, straight onto the can – self-adhesive back, no tools and no glue
  • Lies flat without bubbles at the edges – flat 2D print that follows the surface of the can
  • Enough for the whole row of cans – four sheets of 20 × 20 cm, or put them on the fridge, doors and cabinet doors

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
